notes:
Orrery 0.15.0

Duels
- Your Deck, Extra Deck, GY and Banished now fan out over the field. Hover a card to lift it and read it, drag it straight onto the field or into your hand, or right-click for its usual actions. There's a filter box, and a grid button for the old window (or pick Grid in Settings > Controls).
- Excavate: from the Deck's menu or by typing /excavate 3 in chat. The top cards show in the fan, and each one can go to your hand, the GY, banishment or the bottom of the Deck without shuffling. Your opponent sees them too.
- Xyz materials and Enfuse Counters circle the card as glowing orbs, passing behind it and in front, with a number badge in the corner. Detaching a material sends its orb flying to the GY.
- View Materials opens in the fan too.
- Your opponent's hand shows as their sleeve fanned out, and a revealed hand fans out face-up; hover a card to read it.
- Right-click a monster's ATK/DEF numbers for the quick stat menu (it opened the normal card menu before).
- The Maximum Summon effect is no longer hidden behind the cards sliding together.

Chat commands
- Every Tools button now has a chat command: /coin, /roll, /remind, /pin, /token, /undo, /redo, /addcard, /restrictions. Type /help in duel chat for the full list.
- Don't need a button? Hide it in Settings > Controls; its command still works.

Achievements and collection
- 14 new achievements, 6 of them secret until you earn them. Achievements are now checked after every duel.
- Hat Trick now counts duels won in a row (it was counting days you opened the app).
- Collection Overview shows how much of each archetype you own; hover one to see what's missing.
- Trading: put cards in a binder with "trade" in its name and your partner sees them marked "for trade", listed first.

Faster
- Card art is saved in a small cache after the first time you see it, so it shows up almost instantly afterwards, even after restarting. Duels load your deck's art in advance, and the Deck Builder, Database and Shop load the next page while you look at this one.
- Smoother hovering in the new fans, and a slightly faster start-up.
- The download is about 30 MB smaller.

Fixes
- After reconnecting to an online duel, changed ATK/DEF/Level, notes, equips and "until end of turn" changes now come back too.
- Closing the app during an online duel no longer leaves a crash report behind.
- Opening a pack with lots of duplicates no longer stacks up the +1 stamp sound.
